# Scientific American

> > Scientific American provides science journalism, research insights, and educational content through digital and print subscriptions.

This site offers access to Scientific American's magazine content, including subscription options for digital and print editions. Published by Springer Nature America, Inc., the platform delivers science news and analysis across multiple formats including web, iOS, and Android.

## Subscription & Access

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm. | Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription plans: digital & print options up to 40% off
